known_speaker_replay: Original 30 examples are a repair/development replay, not a fresh blind-speaker test. No word times or waveforms are changed.

fresh_perturbations.holdout_kind: Previously ungenerated noise realizations and SNR values on known reference clips; not unseen speakers or transcripts.

mechanism: Power-pooled word energy reduces frame-mask median flips. Logarithmic flatness ratio plus periodicity loss detects locally added broadband noise even when absolute flatness is small.
calibration_scope: Analytic fixtures and Obama development observations only. Biden source has already been exposed in v1, so no fresh speaker-generalization claim.
failure_policy: Preserve the frozen result. No tuning on fresh perturbations or repeating unchanged mechanism.
